Sustainable Tourism & Aviation Risk Consultancy

Risk intelligence for a sustainable travel future

Tourisk Advisory is an independent consultancy specialising in risk and crisis management for the travel and aviation sectors, with a focus on sustainability including sustainable aviation fuel (SAF).

Get in touch

About

Independent expertise, rigorous insight

Tourisk Advisory is an independent consultancy specialising in risk and crisis management for the travel and tourism sectors, with a particular focus on sustainability. The practice brings together academic rigour and real-world sector experience to help organisations navigate complex, fast-moving risks.

Based in the UK with an international outlook, Tourisk Advisory works with clients across Europe and beyond.

The practice is led by a PhD candidate at a UK university researching scenario development in crisis and risk management, with a focus on the tourism sector. Having grown up across eight countries and studied internationally, including in Switzerland, there is a genuine understanding of how differently risk plays out depending on where you are in the world.

Focus
Sustainable Tourism & Aviation
Specialism
SAF & Sustainability Risk
Reach
UK & Europe
Approach
Research-led, Practical

What I do

Areas of expertise

Risk Assessment
Identifying and evaluating risks specific to travel and aviation, from destination-level threats and geopolitical exposure to operational and sustainability risks.
Crisis Management
Supporting organisations to respond effectively during critical incidents with clear frameworks, communication strategies and practical decision-making support.
SAF & Sustainability Advisory
Specialist advice on sustainable aviation fuel adoption, sustainability risk and the transition challenges facing aviation, drawing on original academic research.
